verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own pages describe Breeze Assistant, a built-in assistant that builds reports from plain-language requests. They also describe in-product AI agents that act on CRM data: a prospecting agent that reaches out automatically, deal progression that handles next steps, single-goal campaign planning, content creation, and approvable automatic CRM updates and follow-up drafts. Missing for 10: in-depth knowledge-base documentation of how tasks are delegated to Breeze Assistant (scope, limits, permissions) beyond marketing-page claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the delegation works as described.
